summary: The Fed held at 3.75%-4% on 28 October in a 10-2 vote with two dissents for a hike, the ECB held its deposit rate at 2.5% on 29 October, and the BOJ held on 30 October after its September hike. Brent futures closed near $113 on 30 October after touching higher levels intraday, after tanker strikes near Hormuz and unconfirmed claims of attacks on Saudi facilities. Alphabet fell on negative free cash flow while Microsoft reported 48% Azure growth, and SK hynix posted record preliminary Q3 profit. EU gas storage was 74.93% full on 26 October, the lowest for the date since 2011, as NOAA kept an El Nino Advisory with a strong event likely.

reading.title: Tanker Orders Leading Newbuilding Activity With Prices Expected to Remain High Throughout 2027
reading.summary: Banchero Costa reports tanker ordering is leading the latest contracting surge despite high prices.

reading.title: Baltic Dry Index Up for 3rd Day
reading.summary: The Baltic dry bulk index rose 0.1% to 2,714 points, its highest since October 13, with the capesize index also up a third day.

reading.title: Experts: What China wants from the COP31 climate talks
reading.summary: Six experts describe what China is expected to push for at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey.

reading.title: Analysis: China's clean-tech exports in 2026 to avoid as much CO2 as Brazil emits in a year
reading.summary: Estimates the emissions avoided by China's 2026 exports of solar panels, batteries and electric vehicles.

reading.title: Floating nuclear power plant 'has boosted air quality'
reading.summary: Monitoring report says emissions from Russia's floating nuclear plant in Chukotka have fallen almost 80% since it began supplying heat in 2022.

reading.title: Westinghouse to conduct key study for AP1000 in Slovakia
reading.summary: Westinghouse will carry out a six-month front-end engineering and design study for a possible AP1000 at Bohunice.

reading.title: Turkish oil refiner to consider SMR deployment
reading.summary: Tupras, Turkey's largest refiner, will assess small modular reactors for power, heat and steam, with US Trade and Development Agency funding.

reading.title: Group14 Technologies secures $167m for global and European expansion
reading.summary: Group14 closed a 150 million euro Series D equity extension to fund international manufacturing growth.

reading.title: ADS-TEC Energy nears permit for 1GW battery storage facility in Germany
reading.summary: ADS-TEC Energy reports progress on a large battery storage project at the Pulverdingen substation in Germany.

reading.title: Elgin to invest $531m in five UK solar and storage projects
reading.summary: Elgin plans to invest nearly 400 million pounds across five UK projects totalling 230 MW.

reading.title: Argentina's Senate Backs Carbon Market Bill In 60-2 Vote, Opening Door To Billions In Potential Exports
reading.summary: Argentina's Senate overwhelmingly approved legislation moving carbon markets closer to a national regulatory framework.

reading.title: ArcelorMittal, MHI, And BHP Complete Carbon Capture Trial At Gent Steel Plant
reading.summary: ArcelorMittal, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, BHP and Mitsubishi Development completed a carbon capture trial at the Gent steel plant.

reading.title: Nasdaq Launches New Carbon Issuance Calendar In Collaboration With Relae
reading.summary: Nasdaq and Relae released a carbon issuance calendar giving buyers a single platform for upcoming credit issuance.

reading.title: Editor's Desk: COP reform is happening quietly, behind the headlines
reading.summary: Argues summits look unchanged but a gradual shift toward implementation is under way alongside negotiation.

reading.title: From Australia to Chile, our cities are driving a green investment boom
reading.summary: City climate commitments could create trillions of dollars of demand for clean technology and green infrastructure.

reading.title: Africa wants adaptation finance on COP31 agenda, raising risk of a fight
reading.summary: The African Group seeks agenda space on tripling adaptation finance, the Green Climate Fund and trade, which could cause a clash.

reading.title: Given a chance, women-led microenterprises uplift Nepali communities & conservation
reading.summary: Profiles a wool-spinning enterprise in Nepal and argues women-led microenterprises give rural families income less dependent on forest products.

reading.title: US lawmakers urge Trump administration to oppose Colombia's Amazon aerial spraying plans
reading.summary: US lawmakers ask the Secretary of State not to back Colombia's plan to resume aerial coca spraying in the Amazon, citing health and environment risks.

reading.title: Aztec methods and crocodiles: How biologists are restoring mangroves in Mexico
reading.summary: Describes a REVIVE-led mangrove restoration in Veracruz using Aztec-inspired planting methods and crocodiles; REVIVE reports full recovery.

reading.title: Mid-term, peak demand, high stakes #319
reading.summary: Newsletter on how energy and climate feature in the US midterms, including state data center and utility policy, plus deal roundups.

reading.title: Trump DOE loans $5B to nuclear plants that will power data centers
reading.summary: Constellation Energy will receive $5 billion in federal loans to modernize its nuclear reactors, with most new capacity committed to Google, Amazon and Meta.

reading.title: Ford Fathom will be the cheapest American EV capable of powering a house
reading.summary: Ford is releasing two chargers supporting vehicle-to-everything power so its EV can power a home or feed the grid.

reading.title: Fusion startups are giving the government shares in exchange for awards. Is it worth it?
reading.summary: Fusion companies must choose between giving the government equity for funding awards or developing without that support.

climate.headline: Panama Canal keeps Neopanamax draft at 49 ft and adds slots from 15 Oct
climate.detail: Canal authority cites Gatun Lake level and near-average rain but says a watershed water deficit continues; 33 daily slots from 15 October. FEWS NET flags a drier Central America Dry Corridor.

climate.headline: Typhoon Champi leaves one dead and about 56,000 Taiwan homes without power
climate.detail: Storm passed Taiwan's northeast on 23 Oct with 259 flights cancelled on 24 Oct; Okinawa lost power to about 8,400 households and Shanghai evacuated tens of thousands.

climate.headline: EU gas storage 74.93% full on 26 Oct, lowest for the date since 2011
climate.detail: About 82.1 bcm held, 14.65 points below the five-year average. Rhine at Kaub rose from 26 cm to 52 cm on 26 Oct, forecast near 77 cm around 29 Oct, likely temporary.
climate.source: GIE data via TASS, 28 Oct 2026; Rhine via Cruise Passenger, 26 Oct 2026

climate.headline: El Niño and positive Indian Ocean Dipole raise Horn of Africa flood and southern Africa drought risk
climate.detail: FEWS NET expects above-average Oct-Dec rain in bimodal East Africa, weak Sahel rains, and below-average Oct-Mar rain in southern Africa, with food insecurity peaking in 2027.

climate.headline: NOAA El Nino Advisory: Nino-3.4 at +2.1C, strong event more than 83% likely through Jan-Mar
climate.detail: Issued 8 Oct; chance of a record 3-month index of +2.5C or more is 83% for Oct-Dec. Next update 12 Nov. Australia's Bureau of Meteorology declared El Nino in June.

climate.headline: India monsoon ended 12.6% below normal; northeast monsoon began 15 Oct
climate.detail: Season rainfall 759.4 mm versus a normal 868.6 mm, attributed mainly to El Nino; the northeast monsoon matters for rabi crops in the south.
climate.source: India Meteorological Department via Business Standard, 15 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Indonesian palm oil areas under half of normal rain; 2027 output seen down about 9%
climate.detail: Sumatra and Kalimantan dry since late June; low Kapuas River blocked tanker movements. Industry group sees 2027 output at 53.69 Mt versus 58.8 Mt in 2026.
climate.source: DTN Ag Weather Forum citing Indonesia Palm Oil Association, 23 Oct 2026
